entries.title: Numbers 13:2
segments: Send thou men; this was no command originally given by Jehovah.  He would have had the people go immediately forward under his all- sufficient guidance,
.  But when the people proposed first to search the land, he was pleased to permit the measure, and to give directions respecting the manner of executing it.

entries.title: Numbers 13:3
segments: God deals with men according to the measure of their faith; those counsels that have their origin in an unbelieving spirit must be expected to have a disastrous issue.

entries.title: Numbers 13:16
segments:
Hoshea; salvation. 
 
  Jehoshua; Jehovah is salvation.  The Greek form of this name is JESUS, of whom Joshua was appointed to be an eminent type.

entries.title: Numbers 13:20
segments:
Fat or lean; fruitful or barren. 
 
  Time of the first ripe grapes; about the month of August.

entries.title: Numbers 13:21
segments:
Wilderness of Zin; lying south of Canaan. 
 
  Rehob; a city near the north part of Canaan. 
 
  Hamath; a city of Syria, lying still further north.

entries.title: Numbers 13:22
segments:
Hebron; a city in the south part of Canaan, about twenty miles from Jerusalem. 
 
  Anak; son of Arba, a distinguished man, after whom Hebron was called Kirjath-Arba, or the city of Arba.

entries.title: Numbers 13:23
segments: Eshcol; a fruitful valley near Hebron.

entries.title: Numbers 13:24
segments: Called the brook Eshcol; Eshcol meaning a cluster.

entries.title: Numbers 13:26
segments: .  It lay on the south border of Canaan, towards Edom.

entries.title: Numbers 13:27
segments: Those who trust the promises of God and follow his directions, will find that what he has promised is true, and their own experience will realize its fulfilment.

entries.title: Numbers 13:28
segments: Children of Anak; a family of giants.

entries.title: Numbers 13:29
segments: Men may do externally what God directs, and yet with such a spirit and for such a purpose as may tend to their ruin.

entries.title: Numbers 13:30
segments: Different men may unite externally in doing the same things, and yet with a very different spirit and for totally different ends.  Thus what is done may be to one a savor of life unto life, and to another a savor of death unto death.

entries.title: Numbers 13:32
segments:
Eateth up the inhabitants; causing them to die from the unhealthiness of the climate, or some other cause.  If this were so, it must have been strange that they were so large and strong. 
 
In making excuses for not doing their duty, and saying that they are not able to do what God requires and is ready to enable them to perform, men are often very inconsistent and contradict themselves.
